kernel_pair.source: CIF_v2 v2.1.0 Pairing (byte-frozen, opencif/reference); Hill fit: glossary macros

P8.status: diagnostic only, not an audit and not gated (docs/LIMITATIONS.md 6): the two criteria of CIF_v2's physics auditor check P8, computed from the design (CIF_v2's auditor is not run on the exported mask; opencif's own drawn-mask checks are assessment.status.drawn_mask_assessment) at the auditor's default operating point (5 uL/min) and at the design flow; its 0.05 Re D_h is the entrance length spec v5, the glossary and CIF_v2 S16-c call wrong in this regime, and its Re limit 1.0 is CIF_v2's settable default (App. B prints no value), not the design envelope's (Re_max = 10, M14)

gates.dean_note: no bound: the channel Reynolds bound 2 rho Q/(mu (h + F_min - 0.1 um)) = 171.05 exceeds 10 (the gated centre-channel Re is Re_max)

fluid.note: water; the Reynolds gates scale with rho/mu

cutoff_band_um.basis: App. B C7 method below the plateau (Hill kappa 3.460 at the widest centre channel)
cutoff_band_um.method: below the plateau (u_min < 0.035): App. B P-C7.1, the frozen Hill fit kappa(u) (glossary \hillKmax, \hillUhalf, \hillN) at u = kappa_g delta*/w_c on the widest centre channel; band [kappa(u) delta*, kappa_g delta*], App. B C7's band for a lamina held at delta* (its Xia-scaled reading; for Dinh V1 [\dinhCollapseLo, \dinhBandHi] = [1.80, 2.17] um, inside the wider [1.25, 2.17] it records because Dinh's schedule is not printed).  Plateau-anchored, not the implicit fixed point d = kappa(d/w_c) delta, which can lie far lower (App. B C7 CQ3).  retention_side: the kappa_g interval x delta*, the band on the plateau

length_budget.definition: each leg along its rows: leg 1 from the head's top, an intermediate leg from half a pitch before its first gap to half a pitch after its last, the last leg to the end of the outlet stretch; U-turns and outlet leads not counted (at least spec v5 G9's sum of Lambda: conservative)

outlet tubing enters the outlet closure as design values (centre 1.56e+12, side 1.12e+10 Pa s/m^3): it is not on the mask and is not measured; the record reports how the last rows depend on it

measured on the drawing: every side segment, head unit length and width, U-turn side and centre arc, outlet lead, gap opening and centre width.  Taken from the design (not measured): the post length across the flow (gap length l_g) and so the side channels' inner edge, the radii of the head and outlet arcs (their widths are measured), the head rows' centre-path lengths, and any off-chip tubing.
